final_message:
I've built the location report from the blank template. The main problem is that the receiving log and "Inv on line" don't overlap at all, so only one item could be shown as stored away, and its received quantity is still blank.

**What the cross-reference showed**
- **None of the 3 items on the 6/24/25 receiving log has a line location:** P21-L44S38-30, P04-J63M12-40 and P07-P98K45-20 aren't in "Inv on line" (127 items, all starting P11-). I also checked for the same part numbers under a different prefix or suffix and found none.
- **P11-P09457-01 isn't on the receiving log at all.** The assignment says half of it was received and moved to its line location, but the log gives no PO, supplier or received quantity for it.

**How the report handles this** (sheet "Location Report", dated 6/24/25)

| Item | Qty Rec'd | Moved From | Moved To | Qty Moved | Balance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| P11-P09457-01 | blank (to confirm) | Receiving dock (WMS staging) | A-300-K02 | half of Qty Rec'd | other half |
| P21-L44S38-30 | 200 | Receiving dock (WMS staging) | NOT MOVED | 0 | 200 |
| P04-J63M12-40 | 25 | Receiving dock (WMS staging) | NOT MOVED | 0 | 25 |
| P07-P98K45-20 | 500 | Receiving dock (WMS staging) | NOT MOVED | 0 | 500 |

- **P11-P09457-01:** I didn't guess a quantity. The Qty Rec'd cell is highlighted yellow, and Qty Moved and Balance fill in automatically once someone enters it.
- **The three logged items:** the full 725 units stay in the receiving dock for tomorrow. I didn't make up locations for them.
- **Totals:** the totals row covers only the three logged items (725 received, 0 moved, 725 left), because P11-P09457-01 has no logged quantity.
- **Remarks:** I added a Remarks column to the template so each row says why it was or wasn't moved.

**Decisions for you or a supervisor**
- **P11-P09457-01 quantity:** this needs to come from the WMS or packing slip, and the receipt should be added to the log.
- **What "half" means:** I read it as half the received quantity moved to the line and the other half left in the dock, since the task says leftover stock is counted the next day. If it actually means a half shipment arrived and all of it was moved, change Qty Moved to equal Qty Rec'd and the balance becomes 0.
- **"Moved From" code:** I used "Receiving dock (WMS staging)" because no WMS staging location code was provided. Swap in the real code when posting.
- **Line locations for the three logged items:** someone needs to assign them, or confirm whether the part numbers are wrong.

Supplier back-orders from the log (50, 0 and 500) aren't part of the Balance column. They appear only on a second sheet that shows the full cross-reference. A third sheet lists each exception and assumption with who needs to act on it.

DONE
